candidate_origin: An unregistered single-to-double synonymous OOD idea was explored at schema/count level before this reproducibility protocol was frozen. No model, functional endpoint, confidence interval, p-value, or generator was run.
scientific_question: Can the MAGE-seq codon-pair assay support a fixed-protein confirmatory model comparison trained on synonymous single-codon variants and evaluated on synonymous double-codon variants in both assayed pair contexts?
mutation_order: Number of positions whose observed codon differs from the unique is_wt=1 codon in the same pair context.
synonymous_definition: At both positions, standard genetic-code translation of the observed codon equals standard genetic-code translation of the WT codon; WT rows are excluded from variant counts.

confirmatory_design_requirements.rationale: The candidate requires a nonzero synonymous-single training set and at least two synonymous-double OOD constructs in each pair context so that a context-specific OOD spread is not defined by a singleton. This is a design-feasibility rule, not a power analysis or a claim that smaller descriptive analyses are impossible.

decision.if_any_pair_fails: FIXED_PROTEIN_SINGLE_TO_DOUBLE_SYNONYMOUS_OOD_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_SAMPLE_COVERAGE; no model fit or functional endpoint evaluation
